items.label: [Computer Desk with Charging Station]
items.value: The computer desk includes a built-in 3 power outlets and 2 USB charging ports for your phone, bluetooth, headset, tablet, power bank, gaming gear with fast charging, which provides a great convenience to your life when you are working or playing games.

items.label: [Gaming Desk with LED Lights]
items.value: Equipped with a built-in RGB LED lights strip, the led gaming desk provides 20 changeable colors, 22 dynamic modes, 5 adjustable brightness levels and 10 lighting rhythms. Properly adjust different lighting atmospheres to create more comfortable office or gaming space.

items.label: [Desk with Fabric File Cabinet and Drawers]
items.value: Coming with 3 Fabric Drawers and a file cabinet allowing you hold letter/A4 size files to prevent documents from falling into dust. Also with 3 open shelves, which provide more storage space for placing printers, scanners or other office machines, keeps its within easy reach of desk.

items.label: [Office Desk with Full-Size Monitor Stand]
items.value: Home office desk with 60" long monitor stand and open shelves. The monitor stand can easily raise the screen to the level parallel to our eyes, use the stand to move the monitor to any position at any time when you feel tired, effectively reduce the pressure on the neck and back.

items.label: [Reversible Sturdy Reading desk]
items.value: The durable study desk can be installed on the left or right side according to your preference, better adapting to your usage habits.
